title: Instruments that read true
summary: Precision measuring equipment, calibrated by hand, for laboratories and production lines where a reading has to be right the first time.
body: Northwind has made instruments in the same Sheffield workshop for fifty-one years. Every unit is calibrated by hand and carries the certificate of the engineer who signed it off. We employ forty-one people and we have never moved production offshore.
points: Serviced by the people who built it
author: dana okoro
